name: com.justconnectus/public
title: JustConnectUs: jobs in Israel
description: Search jobs in Israel by role and city: 6,500+ openings at 700+ companies, with apply links. Daily.

tools.name: search_jobs_in_israel
tools.description:
Open jobs in Israel at every company we follow (700+, from startups to Intel and Teva), by role, city or remote, newest first, 50 a page. Each job has the company and a link to the posting on the company's own careers site, where people apply. Read daily from the companies' careers sites, so the openings are current.
Use when: the person is looking for a job in Israel or asks what is open: "find me DevOps jobs in Tel Aviv", "remote product manager jobs in Israel", "nursing jobs in Haifa", "English-speaking jobs in Jerusalem", "what jobs are there for a QA engineer?". Also for olim and anyone moving to Israel. Not for: one named company's openings, or which companies are hiring.
Input: `role` in the person's words (a role like "data scientist", or title words like "react developer"); `city` in English ("Tel Aviv", "Petah Tikva"; nearby towns are included); `remote` true for remote jobs only; `page` from `next_page`. All optional; with none, the newest jobs in Israel.
Returns: `jobs[]` with `title`, `company` (`name`, `slug` for the company tools), `url` (the job on JustConnectUs), `apply_url` (the posting on the company's site), `locations`, `remote`, `work_arrangement`, `employment_type`, `roles`, `language` (en or he: the ad's language), `posted_at` and `summary` (the start of the ad; the full text is at `apply_url`); `matched_roles` (the job roles the words matched; jobs whose title has every word match too), `city` (the city searched), `total`, `next_page`. An unknown city is an error with code `city_not_found`.

role.description: The job, in the person's words: a role ("DevOps Engineer", "product manager", "nurse") or words from job titles ("react developer")

city.description: A city in Israel in English, e.g. "Tel Aviv", "Haifa", "Jerusalem", "Herzliya"

page.description: Page number, from `next_page` of the previous call (50 a page)

tools.name: list_companies_hiring_in_israel
tools.description:
Which companies are hiring in Israel right now: Israeli companies, startups and international companies with offices in Israel, each with its open job count and a link to its own careers page. Read daily from the companies' careers sites.
Use when: the person is job hunting in Israel and asks which companies are hiring, which startups or tech companies to apply to, for a company's careers page, or looks up a company by name; also for companies to approach directly, including small startups with no careers page (`hiring_only` false). Not for: one company's openings.
Input: `query` is part of a name ("check point"); `hiring_only` defaults to true (false includes companies with no openings right now); `careers_page` true or false keeps only companies with or without a careers page (combine with `hiring_only` false to see companies without one); `sort` most_openings or name; `page` from `next_page`.
Returns: `companies[]` with `name`, `slug`, `website`, `careers_page_url` (the company's own site; null when no careers page is known), `open_jobs`, `jobs_followed` (false: we don't read this company's openings, so `open_jobs` 0 doesn't mean it isn't hiring), `linkedin_url` (the company's LinkedIn page; null when unknown), `jobs_url` (its openings on JustConnectUs) and `on_justconnectus` (true: it takes applications and referrals on JustConnectUs); `total`, `next_page`, and `counts` for the whole directory (`companies`, `hiring`, `jobs`, `careers_pages`).

query.description: Part of a company name, e.g. "check point" or "teva"

hiring_only.description: Only companies with open jobs now (default true)

careers_page.description: true: only companies with a careers page; false: only companies without one (often small startups, reached through their website or LinkedIn). Leave out for both

page.description: Page number, from `next_page` of the previous call (50 a page)

tools.name: get_company_careers
tools.description:
One company hiring in Israel: its careers page, website, open job count, and the roles and cities it is hiring for most.
Use when: the person names a company ("is Wiz hiring?", "what does Mobileye hire for?", "Check Point careers page") and wants its careers page or what it is hiring for. Not for: the list of jobs.
Input: `company` is a `slug` from list_companies_hiring_in_israel or a name, e.g. "Wiz". When several companies match a name, or none does but some are spelled alike, the error lists them in `candidates`.
Returns: the company as in list_companies_hiring_in_israel (`careers_page_url` may be null and `jobs_followed` false), plus `top_roles[]` and `top_cities[]` (`name`, `slug`, `open_jobs`).

company.description: The company: its `slug` from list_companies_hiring_in_israel (e.g. "wiz"), or its name (e.g. "Check Point")

tools.name: list_company_jobs
tools.description:
The open jobs at one company in Israel (or remote from Israel), newest first, 50 a page, each with a link to the posting on the company's own site, where people apply.
Use when: the person wants a named company's openings ("jobs at Wix", "does Monday.com have DevOps jobs in Tel Aviv?"). Not for: comparing companies.
Input: `company` as in get_company_careers; optional `role` (a slug from `top_roles`, or words from a role name: "devops" matches DevOps Engineer, "engineer" every engineering role) and `city` ("Tel Aviv"); `page` from `next_page`.
Returns: `company`, `matched_roles` (with `role`: the company's roles it matched; when none, `available_roles` lists the roles it is hiring for), and `jobs[]` with `title`, `url` (the job on JustConnectUs), `apply_url` (the posting on the company's site, where people apply), `locations`, `work_arrangement`, `employment_type`, `roles`, `language`, `posted_at` and `summary` (the start of the ad; the full text is at `apply_url`); `total`, `next_page`.

company.description: The company: its `slug` from list_companies_hiring_in_israel (e.g. "wiz"), or its name (e.g. "Check Point")

role.description: A role slug from get_company_careers `top_roles` ("software-engineer"), or words from a role name ("devops")

city.description: A city in Israel in English or its slug, e.g. "Tel Aviv" or "tel-aviv"

page.description: Page number, from `next_page` of the previous call (50 a page)
